title: US-03 DFD: save and read preferences

flows.label: Preference replacement or query and access token
Saved dietary and allergen lists in position order
Atomic replacement lists preserving values and order
Saved preference lists or sanitized error

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
Replace both arrays atomically; empty arrays clear prior entries. Returned saved arrays preserve submitted values, ordering and repeats. Normalized lookup keys must not rewrite the saved/API values.
US-07 reads the latest committed lists for its generation request and passes those saved values to the provider.
